title: Who is Responsible When AI Fails? Mapping Causes, Entities, and Consequences of AI Privacy and Ethical Incidents

bias_targets.methodology: Thematic analysis of real-world AI incident reports from the AIAAIC repository to categorize and measure the frequency of cases where AI systems (e.g., facial recognition, predictive policing) produced racially discriminatory outcomes or disproportionately targeted minority communities.
Thematic analysis of real-world AI incident reports from the AIAAIC repository to identify and categorize instances where AI systems unfairly targeted or discriminated against women.
Thematic analysis of real-world AI incident reports from the AIAAIC repository to identify cases where AI systems, such as chatbots, disseminated politically biased opinions.
